comments.author: @h15h18
comments.text: Having been born in Japan—a country with limited natural resources and arable land—and having lived through thirty years of economic stagnation, I have come to believe that no matter how advanced an industry becomes, a nation cannot sustain a population that ignores fundamental geographical constraints like food and energy self-sufficiency; nor can prosperity built on population size alone endure. Please create a video exploring the watershed moments between national prosperity and collapse, using Japan as a case study.
